title: Chapter 1885: Loose Ends Settled (I)
content:
Chapter 1885: Loose Ends Settled (I)

Li Ximing anxiously rode the wind home. Only after leaving the Sea Within the Mansion did he breathe a little easier. He crossed the dense jungles of Poluoduo, and returned to Song by way of the Southern Sea. It was not until the familiar great lake came into view that he finally relaxed.

That ghastly thing... Thankfully, it hasn't come after me.

Already delighted by his considerable gains, he now felt even better. Descending into the mountains, he found quite a gathering!

The green-robed Daoist Master sat meditating in the pavilion, a book resting on his knees. He was studying it closely while calculating on his fingers. Two people stood beside him. The elder stroked his beard, looking perfectly at ease, while the spirited young man held mercury-colored light in his palm.

Besides Daoist Master Qinghu, who had been invited to guard the lake, Xianyao and his disciple Chengqian were here as well!

"Fellow Daoists!"

The pair seemed to have come to see Sima Yuanli. At Li Ximing's smiling greeting, the green-robed Daoist Master immediately rose. He took a single look at Li Ximing’s expression, and exclaimed, "To have secured your gains in so little time, fellow Daoist. Impressive indeed!"

The Western Sea was distant, after all. Li Ximing had spent several months preparing for the journey, and gathering information, refining pills, and making arrangements had all taken time. Even after Li Zhouwei returned, he still had to settle matters with Daomian. It had been more than a year since he had departed.

Sima Yuanli clearly had contacts in the Western Sea, and knew exactly how little time dealing with the demonic creature had actually taken. His smile was courteous as he welcomed Li Ximing back.

Li Ximing said, "I spent some time attending to private affairs. I was worried that, being away for so long, the north might stir again. Thank you for guarding the lake for my family, Daoist Master."

"No trouble at all... One can cultivate anywhere." Sima Yuanli smiled warmly and brought his hands together. "The King of Wei dealt Ch'i Lanyan a painful blow. He's busy answering for it!"

With three Daoist Masters at the entrance, Li Ximing could hardly leave them standing there. He led everyone inside, and they took their seats in the mountains.

Sima Yuanli said with a smile, "Congratulations, fellow Daoist! I've heard of Shehu as well. He had a certain treasure..."

Li Ximing already knew what he was thinking. With a faint smile, he drew his hand from his sleeve, revealing a brilliant green jewel resting in his palm.

It was Shehu's [Orthodox Wood] spirit embryo!

Sima Yuanli was not without a spirit embryo. Though Daoist Master Yuanxiu had been unable to predict when he would break through and had left none for him, he now possessed both a spirit artifact and a spirit treasure. Why would he spend time refining a spirit embryo he considered beneath him?

Though the artifact had been crudely refined, it had endured the Heavenly Crow Merging Fire for quite some time. Li Ximing therefore knew that Shehu's [Orthodox Wood] spirit embryo was made of exceptional material.

Sure enough, Sima Yuanli's eyes lit up, and he joked, "If you want another [Bright Truth Harmonizing Divine Pill], Zhaojing, I truly have none left!"

Though spoken in jest, his words made Li Ximing pause. He smiled in return. "You guessed exactly right. What a pity."

He merely smiled without answering, then turned his hand over and put the spirit embryo away on the spot. Whether for formations or the two juniors' future cultivation, the Li Family still needed vast quantities of spirit items. But Li Ximing had plenty of spirit items and spirit materials on hand. Why hurry to trade?

Spirit embryos deteriorate. In five or six years, this one's value will fall considerably, but there is still plenty of time. Sima Yuanli is the one who should be anxious.

Leaving Sima Yuanli to his silent deliberations, he turned to the others. Sure enough, Chengqian asked courteously, "Senior, did you happen to... see that demonic creature use a treasured basin?"

He was unsurprised that Sima Yuanli had anticipated his gains, but Chengqian's knowledge was rather odd. Suspicion stirred in Li Ximing's mind, though he replied with a smile, "You are well informed."

Chengqian had worked alongside Li Ximing before, and had always been clever and perceptive. He was an exceptionally promising junior.

Chengqian replied, "It is not for me. A friend asked about it, saying he was very interested. But his particular identity prevented him from meeting Shehu to trade for it, so he had never managed to obtain it."

Li Ximing understood at once.

A Buddhist cultivator.

Clearly, these Eastern Sea cultivators did not draw as firm a distinction between the Immortal and Buddhist Daos as the Supreme Yang lineages did. Chengqian probably knew quite a few Buddhist cultivators.

Li Ximing poured some tea and said casually, "It is in my possession. That depends on what he offers in exchange."

Chengqian's lips moved slightly. Guided by his divine ability, his voice reached Li Ximing's ears, clear and decisive.

I am willing to trade for it on his behalf. How about two portions of [Spirit Chalice Radiance]?

Li Ximing was tempted.

Li Zhouwei had once obtained a portion of [Spirit Chalice Radiance] at Changxiao Gate, which Li Ximing had used to excellent effect. It was particularly useful to cultivators like him, whose Dao conduct was limited and who found advancing their arts especially difficult. He was sorely tempted, but the two offers were not equal in value.

He smiled. "A fine offer, but this basin is made of exceptional material. It is still not enough. Why not look for spirit items of Radiant Fire or Whole Pill?"

Almost all their gains from Guangchan had gone into Li Zhouwei's weapon, so Li Ximing was naturally planning for the future. His words were meant not only for Chengqian, but also for Daoist Master Qinghu beside him. Meanwhile, he had another calculation in mind.

This is not my only option. A Buddhist cultivator is going to such lengths to inquire, and Chengqian is eager enough to trade for it himself. It must be worth a great deal. Wouldn't I risk losing out if I didn't ask Minghui first?

Even as he considered this, the master and disciple showed no intention of leaving. Chengqian lowered his eyes in thought, but Xianyao unexpectedly took the chance to speak.

He had hesitated for a long time, but ultimately, a trace of bitterness crossed his face. "It is fortunate that I happened to meet you, Zhaojing. Having heard of your family's great renown, I have a few words to offer in confidence. I only fear you may find me tiresome."

Li Ximing gave him a curious look and nodded for him to continue. The Daoist Master chose his words carefully as he said, "Shehu may not have been particularly formidable, but there was a reason he had secured his position. The Western Mansion Origin Grotto Gate and the other Daoist Masters may have no grounds to object, but they are deeply displeased. Those whose source of spirit materials was destroyed must bear some resentment as well..."

Li Ximing had expected something of the sort and merely smiled. Xianyao continued, "I understand that your family is short of resources, and the [Heavenly Nurturing Urn] bestowed by his majesty offers a way to make up the deficit. But traveling so far to slay a divine ability cultivator with whom you have no prior grievance is rather ruthless. It does your reputation no good."

Li Ximing's smile faded slightly as he grasped the old man's meaning. Still smiling, he replied, "That makes no sense. Perhaps you could explain it clearly! When the Chi Family sent Jiangnan's cultivators to defend the river and feed the Buddhist cultivators' insatiable desires, I heard no one call it ruthless. When the Murong Family came south, feasting on blood food to perfect their Dao conduct, no one came knocking to question them either. I had thought that slaying a man-eating demon would hardly earn me a reputation for ruthlessness. Apparently, I was mistaken."

Though delivered gently across the table, his words conveyed little agreement. Worry flickered in Chengqian's eyes. Sima Yuanli merely smiled in silence as though he had heard nothing, while Xianyao sighed. "Forgive an old man a few unwelcome words. Commoners are commoners. However many there are, they remain commoners.

“But a divine ability cultivator is an immortal, even if there is only one. Once we attain divine abilities, we are all fellow Daoists. Countless commoners suffer and die, but a divine ability cultivator is not slain without cause. He had already retreated to the Western Sea. With no grievance between you, you should at least have left him some dignity... Killing him would have been one thing. Why capture and torment him?

"If you had secretly taken blood to nourish your spirit treasure, Zhaojing, even those who learned of it would merely praise your resourcefulness. But capturing a divine ability cultivator to consume his flesh and strip his hide would make anyone frown... This time it was Shehu. Who will it be next time?

"As for claiming that being a man-eating demon is itself grounds for execution... that is all the more certain to invite chaos."

Looking troubled, he cupped his hands. "An evil demonic creature may indeed be evil, but he cannot be executed merely for that. Otherwise, wouldn't every divine ability cultivator fear for their safety? If your Li Family raises the banner of the Orthodox Dao, whom could you not kill?

“This is how Douxuan's Heaven-Governing acts, and it is out of step with the times. The world belongs to those who have attained the Dao. Those who use the ignorant judgments of commoners to govern such people will surely be overthrown... History has proven it time and again."
